snippet.title: Between Adventures IDLE - Idle RPG Strategy - Teaser (Steam)
snippet.description:
An Idle RPG Strategy game where you gather resources in a magical world, battle powerful creatures, and upgrade your gear. Explore new locations through main and side quests; your progress continues even in the background. A simple and enjoyable idle experience awaits you.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3702540/Between_Adventures_IDLE/
